props.heading: Authenticity proof, explained clearly.
props.description: This optional proof path uses wallet control and a cryptographic signature check as one transparent identity signal. It is not a replacement for reviewing the projects, writing, and public evidence behind the portfolio.

props.heading: Verify a wallet-based authenticity signal
props.description: Connect a compatible wallet and sign the presented message to demonstrate control of that wallet. No transaction is requested.
props.note: Wallet control is one limited identity signal. Review the portfolio's public projects, documentation, and source links for broader evidence of authorship and work.

props.heading: Evidence belongs in context.
props.description: Explore the research record, writing, and project evidence that make this portfolio useful to review.
